chunk_content: If an AGYW has Microfinance, Economic Strengthening - Vocational Training received more than one service, they should be counted only once. Age Group Targeted: • 18-19,20-24 years 5. Education Subsidies Definition This is a count of all AGYW who received an Education subsidy intervention within the financial year. DREAMS Variables Required Education Support – Uniform, Education Support – Stationery, Education Support-School Fees, Education Support - Other Notes: • An AGYW is counted under this indicator if she has received at least one of the listed services. If one has received more than one service, they should be counted only once. Age Group Targeted: • 10-14,15-17,18-19,20-24 years 6. Entrepreneurship Training Definition This is a count of all AGYW who received an Entrepreneurship training intervention within the financial year. DREAMS Variables Required Economic Strengthening - Entrepreneurship Training Notes: • This is a one-off intervention i.e. an AGYW will only receive this service once during their stay in the program. Despite this, only Entrepreneurship Training offered within the current financial year will be counted against the target given. Age Group Targeted • 18-19,20-24 years 7. Financial Capabilities Training This is a count of all AGYW who received financial capabilities training intervention within the financial year. Definition DREAMS Variables Required Economic Strengthening – Financial Capabilities Training Notes • This is a one-off intervention i.e. an AGYW will only receive this service once during their stay in the program. Despite this, only Financial Capability Training offered within the current financial year will be counted against the target given. Age Group Targeted • 10-14,15-17,18-19,20-24 years 8. HIV Testing Services Definition This is a count of all AGYW who received HIV Testing Services (HTS) within the financial year. DREAMS Variables Required • HTS(Client), HTS (Client Linked to HTS), Respect-K Notes: An AGYW is counted under this indicator if she has received at least one of these services. If she receives more than one service, she is counted only once. Age Group Targeted • 10-14,15-17,18-19,20-24 years 9. Parenting/Caregiver Programs Definition This is a count of all AGYW whose parents/caregivers were reached with a parenting/caregiver program within the financial year. DREAMS Variables Required Parent/Caregiver Program - FMP I, Parent/Caregiver Program - FMP II Notes • This is a one-off intervention i.e. an AGYW will only receive this service once during their stay in the program (unless they transition in age and become eligible for a different intervention). Despite this, only Parenting/Caregiver Programs offered within the current financial year will be counted against the target given. Age Group Targeted o FMP I- 10-14 years o FMP II-15-19 years 10. Post Violence Care Definition This is a count of all AGYW who have received a post violence care intervention within the financial year.
